regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information badge
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate claim were inspected. The badge indicates availability but source_mapping.json leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.
Conceptual central-to-axial chirality comparison between cited optically active routes and a racemic catalytic concept; classified as a general scheme, not individual experiments.
Generic catalytic-design route from propargylic alcohols/carbonates to chiral 2,3-allenoates; classified as a general scheme because R groups and experiment-specific outcomes are unspecified.
The introduction and the Pd(dba)2/(S)-Segphos/(NH4)2HPO4 sentence describe cited prior work or design context. They were not mislabeled as current-paper preparative experiments.

unresolved: Generic schemes do not support unique structures, full conditions, or experiment-specific outcomes.
No Supporting Information file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 2 left-column Table 1 reaction drawing, ligand structures, rows 1–5, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Five ligand-skeleton optimization experiments were retained row-by-row with shared catalyst/base/solvent/CO conditions, row times, isolated yields, product ee, and NMR starting-material recovery.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–9, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Nine BIPHEP aryl-substituent rows were retained independently. Entry 1 is 0% product/97% recovery; entry 4 uses (S)-L4 and prints signed −60% ee; entry 9 is at 45 °C.

regions.region: page 2 prose introducing Table 3 and equation (1)
regions.finding: Shared Table 3 catalyst/loadings, LiF 1.1 equiv, CO balloon, toluene, 25 °C, and 24 h were linked to the 18 row records on page 3. SI-only Tables S1–S4 were not reconstructed.

unresolved: Tables 1–2 omit solvent volume, workup, purification, isolated masses, and ee analytical methods.
Table 3 details visible only in unavailable SI were not inferred; compact structures remain machine candidates or labels.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 3 reaction header, conditions A–C, products 2a–2r, and footnote a
regions.finding: Eighteen substrate-scope experiments were retained row-by-row with 1 mmol scale, condition-specific catalyst/ligand loadings, LiF, CO balloon, 25 °C, yields and ee values; 2k keeps the 37 h footnote. Recovered 1b has 78% ee but no reported recovery amount.
Distinct opposite-enantiomer experiment retained: 1f with (S)-ECNU-Phos gives (S_a)-2f in 78% reported yield and 94% ee under the printed 1 mmol/25 °C/24 h conditions.
Two independent applications of (R_a)-2f were retained: DIBAL-H reduction to allenol 4 (64%, 93% ee) and I2 cyclization to lactone 3 (84%, 92% ee; 99% ee after recrystallization).

regions.region: page 3 center-right crystal image and configuration discussion
regions.finding: X-ray analysis supports the reported absolute configuration of lactone 3 and assignment of (R)-ECNU-Phos products, but it is not a separate reaction and does not mark machine structures verified.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 4 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Explicit working model through proposed (R,R)-5, (S,R)-5, and 6; classified as mechanism rather than observed preparative steps.

unresolved: Table 3 does not state workup, purification, isolated masses, yield basis, or ee method.
Several compact Table 3 structures cannot be confidently converted to full SMILES and remain source labels.
Scheme 3 omits scale and operational details; Scheme 4 intermediates are proposed rather than isolated.

regions.finding: The paper states that procedures, analytical data, and spectra are available as Supporting Information, but no SI is explicitly associated in the workspace; no SI facts were inferred.

Pengbin Li is thanked for reproducing Table 3 products (R_a)-2c, (R_a)-2i, and (R_a)-2o. The statement was linked to the three existing records without creating duplicates because no separate conditions or measurements are supplied.

regions.region: page 4 remaining References 1–23 and crystallographic note
regions.finding: Bibliography and CCDC metadata are prior literature/structure-support context, not current-paper reaction experiments; no external-paper records were created.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment lacks independent run identifiers, quantities, conditions, and outcomes.
Supporting Information association remains unestablished; references and CCDC data were not imported as experiments.
